description: Node 22's MessageEvent (undici 6.23's), which jsh makes itself rather than load the platform's (#566): its prototype, name and descriptors; the constructor's WebIDL conversions and their TypeErrors (argument count, a symbol type, a non-object init, ports and source not MessagePorts, a null init's missing defaults, the order the init's members are read in); the brand checks; initMessageEvent; inspect; a port's messages are instances of the global MessageEvent (a BroadcastChannel's are in broadcast-channel-node22, which needs slicc-kernel 1.92.0)
